editorNote: Two threads today. OpenAI published how it secures its frontier training environment, and press reports say it has stopped training on the live internet; read together, they show labs tightening control over training data and infrastructure. Separately, Moonshot's Kimi 3.1 Pro open-weights release is drawing attention for narrowing the gap with closed models. Also worth a look: mitigation steps for the PHP2Shell vulnerability.
